Forwarding anonymous report from #Mapy.cz user, please verify: "Not yellow and red sign.Yellow and blue sign from this point to Kékes." / Updated about 1 year ago by Bodocs Balazs
There is a "yellow +" sign to Mátraháza, a "yellow -" sign to Mátraháza on another route and "yellow -" sign to Kékestető. Together with the "yellow -" sign there is a "blue ^^" called "A Mátra bércein". This last one is marked as red on the map incorrectly. / Resolved 1 day ago by sfphoton
I checked the relation "A Mátra bércein", however it does not specify anything red, maybe it's a default on your renderer: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/5563755 I have added colour=blue in an attempt to specify this. Sadly, I could not add the machine-parseable osmc:symbol tag as it is too complex. I'm closing this note as I think there is nothing else left to do. If you still find this way red, please file an issue for your map application or reopen this note.
